title: Chef John's Fresh Spring Rolls
description: Chef John uses rice paper wrappers and ingredients he has on hand--cooked chicken, bell peppers, English cucumbers, carrots, and fresh herbs--to make his versatile spring rolls.
ingredients: 1 cooked chicken breast half, cut into thin strips
1 red bell pepper, cut into thin strips
1 English cucumber, cut into thin strips

steps.text: Soak a rice paper wrapper in cold water just until it becomes flexible, 1 minute or less. Place on a slightly damp towel. Place some baby greens near the bottom of the round. Top with strips of chicken and pepper, leaving about a 1-inch margin on the sides. Roll tightly just until the bottom edge meets the center of the paper and sticks there. Then continue to add more chicken strips and vegetable strips. Finish with torn pieces of herbs. Complete the roll, pressing the ingredients to keep roll tight and tucking in the sides.

Transfer completed rolls to a plate lined with damp paper towels. Cover each roll with damp papers towels as you work to prevent them from drying out; don't let the rolls touch each other or they will stick together.

video.description: In this video, Chef John will show you how to make fresh spring rolls. First he demonstrates how to achieve the perfect working consistency for rice papers. He fills them with cooked chicken, fresh veggies and herbs, but recommends you get creative and try this with your favorite ingredients. Don’t fear the fresh spring roll! This technique is not going to let you down.
